children: Revenue rose year over year as residential community acquisitions and improved occupancy offset sales of scattered single-family units. The net loss attributable to common stockholders narrowed, helped by lower real estate impairment charges and acquisition-cost reimbursements, partly offset by higher interest expense.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per common share – Diluted”.
: Quarterly rental and other property revenue increased 40.7% year over year to $12.8M; net operating income rose 43.8% to $6.7M.
: Quarterly revenue fell 19.8% to $6.0M, while segment NOI declined 43.7% to $1.8M; units at Ballast and Golden Pacific were intentionally held vacant for sale.
: Average occupancy was 89.6% in the quarter, down 160 basis points year over year; residential communities were 93.7% occupied.
: The company had 440 consolidated units under development or in lease-up; 47 of 82 acquired Parkside at Summers Corner units were occupied at September 30, 2026.
